items.source: You can also configure the ForwardedHeaderFilter with removeOnly, in which case it removes but does not use the headers.
items.translation: 您也可以使用removeOnly配置 ForwardedHeaderFilter，在这种情况下，它会移除但不使用这些标头。

items.source: Note that although a filter can be mapped to handle specific dispatcher types via web.xml or in Java through the ServletContext, servlet containers may enforce different defaults with respect to dispatcher types. This flag enforces the design intent of the filter.
items.translation: 注意，尽管可以通过 `web.xml` 将过滤器映射到处理特定分发器类型，或通过 Java 中的 ServletContext 进行配置，但 servlet 容器可能会针对分发器类型强制执行不同的默认设置。此标志强制实施过滤器的设计意图。

items.source: By default, if this property is set to false, in which case calls to HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect(String) are overridden in order to turn relative into absolute URLs, also taking into account forwarded headers.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果将此属性设置为 false，则调用`HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect(String)` 将被覆盖，以将相对 URL 转换为绝对 URL，同时考虑转发头。

items.source: The default implementation always returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回false。

items.source: Sub-classes may use this method to filter such nested ERROR dispatches and re-apply wrapping on the request or response. ThreadLocal context, if any, should still be active as we are still nested within the filter chain.
items.translation: 子类可以使用此方法过滤此类嵌套的 ERROR 分发，并在请求或响应上重新应用包装。`ThreadLocal`上下文（如果有）仍然应该处于活动状态，因为我们仍处于过滤器链的嵌套中。

items.source:
There are security considerations for forwarded headers since an application
cannot know if the headers were added by a proxy, as intended, or by a malicious
client. This is why a proxy at the boundary of trust should be configured to
remove untrusted Forwarded headers that come from the outside.
items.translation: 由于应用程序无法确定这些标头是由代理按预期添加的，还是由恶意客户端添加的，因此对于转发标头存在安全注意事项。这就是为什么应在信任边界处的代理被配置为移除来自外部的不可信 Forwarded 标头的原因。

items.source:
The default return value is "true", which means the filter will not be
invoked during subsequent async dispatches. If "false", the filter will
be invoked during async dispatches with the same guarantees of being
invoked only once during a request within a single thread.
items.translation: 默认返回值为"true"，这意味着在随后的异步分发中不会调用该过滤器。如果为"false"，则会在异步分发中调用该过滤器，并保证在单个线程的请求中仅被调用一次。

items.source: Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread.
items.translation: 与doFilter相同的合同，但保证在单个请求线程中每个请求仅被调用一次。

items.source: Can be overridden in subclasses for custom filtering control, returning true to avoid filtering of the given request.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写以进行自定义过滤控制，返回 `true` 以避免过滤给定的请求。

items.source: The dispatcher type jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ASYNC means a filter can be invoked in more than one thread over the course of a single request.
items.translation: jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ASYNC 类型的分发器意味着在单个请求期间，过滤器可以在多个线程中被调用。

and the filter chain starts anew.
items.translation: 通常，ERROR 分发会在 REQUEST 分发完成后发生，并且过滤器链会重新开始。
